title: Knowing what happens to every physical part leaves open what happens to the person

statements.text: If a brain were split and each half transplanted, two persons might each claim to be the original, but both cannot be. Which, if either, is the original is a real question, not a matter of definition, yet knowing what happened to every atom of the brain and body would not answer it. So survival is at least in part a fact about a nonphysical part.

sources.quote: won’t always show you what has happened to me
But it cannot be a matter of definition whether I survive a brain operation and what my subsequent life will be like.
